name: Tight mid push into the amp
desc: Steep 140 Hz high-pass and +5 dB at 720 Hz, highs eased: tightens a high-gain amp's palm mutes from the front

refs.why: Misha Mansoor tightens his high-gain amps with an overdrive in front

notes: Placed BEFORE the amp: an overdrive-pedal curve without the clipping. Less bass into the preamp = less flub; +3 dB out hits the input harder
